name: Ichijou Daisuke
source:
The protagonist of the previous BOIN. He is a Japanese teacher at Koromo Gakuen.

He comes to Amanato Island to enjoy his summer vacation. He has to work part-time at the beach house "Triton" after Sal steals all his money.
